title: File:Lenovo keyboard (3453201147).jpg
desc:
I was testing out a laptop for work the other day.
My verdict: I'm glad I don't have a laptop.

It is handy to be able to access all the work servers via my home wifi or from anywhere else via 3G, but I couldn't cope with a 12" screen for any serious work.

desc: Intel Free Press story: Do People Want Touch on Laptop Screens? Consumer tests reveal users want single device with a keyboard that opens, closes and is touch enabled.

title: File:Psion MC200 (23610703586).jpg
art: Jiri Brozovsky from Ostrava, Czech Republic
desc: The first Psion's laptop computer - the MC200. Unlike the MC400 and MC600, this model has a much smaller and greenish screen which is harder to read. That's probably the reason why it is so rare.
